preset.name: linux-clang-hip
preset.comment: Linux clang PhysX SDK with the GPU projects built for AMD GPUs through HIP

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Newer compilers than upstream tests raise extra warnings

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_SNIPPETS_HEADLESS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Snippets run a fixed number of steps and exit

cmakeParam.name: PX_GPU_BACKEND
cmakeParam.comment: Build the GPU projects with HIP instead of CUDA

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path relative to PhysX SDK root
